# CTFtime.org

> > The premier platform for tracking Capture The Flag (CTF) cybersecurity competitions, team rankings, and community-contributed writeups.

CTFtime.org serves as the central hub for the global CTF community, providing comprehensive team ratings, event calendars, and an extensive archive of challenge solutions. The platform tracks competitive cybersecurity teams including RubiyaLab, 0xFUN, r3kapig, and hundreds of others competing in hacking events worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Capture The Flag (CTF)
- CTF team ratings and leaderboards
- Cybersecurity competitions
- CTF writeups and solutions
- Hacking events
- Security challenges
- Forensics
- OSINT (Open Source Intelligence)
- Task archives
- Competitive hacking teams
- Team rankings
- CTF event calendar
- Challenge categories

## Core Platform

- [CTFtime.org Homepage](https://ctftime.org/): Main platform featuring CTF team ratings, global leaderboards, and upcoming competition events

## Writeups & Solutions

- [CTF Writeups Archive](https://ctftime.org/writeups): Comprehensive collection of community-contributed CTF writeups, solutions, and walkthroughs for security challenges across various categories including forensics and OSINT
